"A wooden cabin, a long pool, and nowhere to be."
The idea

Just Pool is a small, unpretentious outdoor pool just outside Tbilisi — the kind of place found by word of mouth rather than a billboard.

A timber A-frame cabin sits at one end, rows of sunbeds line the deck, and the pool itself stays clean, calm, and blue all season. No crowds, no fuss — it's earned its 4.9 rating one quiet afternoon at a time.

Come for a swim before the day heats up, or settle into a sunbed and stay until the light goes gold.

On the deck

Everything a proper pool day needs.

The pool

A well-kept outdoor pool, clean and unhurried — built for a proper swim or a slow float.

Cold drinks, khachapuri, and a menu built to be eaten with wet hands.
